sources.entry: GouvernAI by Myr-Aya - Runtime guardrails for Claude Code. Auto-approve what's safe, gate what's risky, block what's dangerous. Dual enforcement, full audit trail. MIT.

summary.one_liner: A Claude Code plugin that adds runtime guardrails: it auto-approves low-risk actions, pauses for approval on risky ones, and hard-blocks dangerous patterns via PreToolUse hooks.
summary.what_it_does: GouvernAI classifies agent actions into four risk tiers (T1 to T4), with reads and drafts passing silently, file writes auto-approved with a notification, and network calls, config changes, and credential access requiring approval. A skill layer (SKILL.md and Markdown policy files) handles nuanced classification and escalation, while a Python PreToolUse hook (scripts/guardrails-enforce.py) runs on Bash, Write, and Edit calls to deterministically block obfuscated commands, credential exfiltration, catastrophic commands, self-modification of guardrails files, and API keys written into files. Slash commands (/guardrails) set modes such as strict, relaxed, and audit-only, plus an optional token cap, and mode settings persist in guardrails-mode.json. Every gated action is written to a guardrails_log.md audit log. The policy files are plain Markdown the user can read and edit.
use_cases: Add safety prompts to Claude Code without turning off all permissions
Keep Claude Code fast while gating risky actions like deletes and installs
Block accidental credential leaks into committed files
Run unattended Claude Code jobs or CI with logged, non-interactive approval rules
Keep an audit trail of agent actions per session
Cap the payload size of agent actions for cost control
how_to_run: Start a Claude Code session and run /gouvernai to activate the hooks and skill layer
Optional: copy the hook config into ~/.claude/settings.json for hooks that fire from session start (replace ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} with an absolute path)
stack: Claude Code plugin system (hooks.json, skills, slash commands)
notable: Dual enforcement: probabilistic skill-layer tier classification plus deterministic PreToolUse hooks that exit with code 2 to hard-block
Fails closed: if the hook cannot parse its input, it blocks the action
Policies are plain Markdown files (ACTIONS.md, TIERS.md, POLICY.md) the user can edit
Modes (full-gate, strict, relaxed, audit-only) and token cap persist across sessions in guardrails-mode.json
Self-modification protection covers the guardrails files themselves
caveats: Hooks do not intercept MCP tool calls, and the skill layer is the only coverage there; the README says skill compliance varies by model, with smaller models like Haiku less reliable
The hook patterns target Unix/Bash syntax, so PowerShell equivalents are not covered, and the README explicitly says it is not a security boundary against determined adversaries
Manual hook registration in settings.json does not auto-update with the plugin, and the README notes a known Claude Code bug where plugin hooks may not fire without running /gouvernai each session
keywords: keep claude code from deleting files
safety layer for ai coding assistant
